bio: This family-run restaurant in Vienna's beautiful 19th district has its fair share of regulars who come to sample its range of classic, flavoursome Austrian specialities. On the menu, you will find familiar favourites such as Wiener schnitzel, seasonal dishes with game, but also seafood including lobster. The attentive waitstaff and cultivated atmosphere add to the appeal of this place, not to mention the splendid garden terrace!...
